omissions_note: The visible tool definitions expose 17 top-level callable tools or tool entry points. The functions.exec interface also exposes dynamically discoverable nested tools through ALL_TOOLS; their complete schemas are not included in the currently visible definitions. Therefore, a complete inventory of every underlying tool and parameter cannot be verified. Internal implementation details and hidden tools are not accessible for verbatim reporting.

tools.name: web.run
tools.description: Use this tool to access information on the web. Web information from this tool helps you produce accurate, up-to-date, comprehensive, and trustworthy responses.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: ToolCallCompactV1 payload (UTF-8 text). Input must be ONE STRING (NOT JSON).

tools.name: python.exec
tools.description: Execute Python code in your chain of thought. This tool should NOT be called to show code or visualizations to the user.

tools.name: python_user_visible.exec
tools.description: Execute Python code that the user should see, such as code that makes plots, displays tables or dataframes, or outputs user-visible files.

tools.name: container.exec
tools.description: Utilities for interacting with a container, for example, a Docker container.

tools.name: container.feed_chars
tools.description: Feed characters to an exec session's STDIN, wait for output, and optionally flush STDOUT/STDERR.

tools.name: container.open_image
tools.description: Returns the image in the container at the given absolute path.

tools.name: container.download
tools.description: Download a file from a URL into the container filesystem.

tools.name: personal_context.search
tools.description: Retrieve user-specific personal context gathered from multiple underlying sources.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The personal context to search for for the given user.

tools.name: bio.update
tools.description: Persist information across conversations, or submit a request to forget existing information.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Plain text containing new or updated information or a request to forget information.

tools.name: image_gen.text2im
tools.description: Creates new images and edits existing images.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Deprecated parameter. Always pass null. Image generation or editing instructions are inferred automatically from the conversation context, so this field should not be used.

parameters.name: transparent_background
parameters.description: Whether to generate a transparent background.

parameters.name: is_style_transfer
parameters.description: Whether the user's request asks for a stylistic transformation of the image or subject.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: Optional settings for assembling GIF from a spritesheet.

tools.name: safety_settings.get_family_info
tools.description: Read family status and product information for Parental Controls.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Family member user ID returned by get_family_info.

tools.name: safety_settings.get_trusted_contact
tools.description: Read Trusted Contact setup, status, privacy, and notification information.

tools.name: safety_settings.update_parental_control
tools.description: Request a control change after reading family information and parental controls. Requires explicit user approval.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Family member user ID returned by the latest get_family_info response.

parameters.name: control_id
parameters.description: Stable ID for the parental control to change.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The complete new value for a toggle, schedule, or multi-select control.

tools.name: functions.exec
tools.description: Run JavaScript code to orchestrate/compose tool calls. All Code Mode tools are available on the global tools object. Tool names are exposed as normalized JavaScript identifiers. Deferred nested tools may be discovered through ALL_TOOLS.
